high_consensus.description: Real gating gap with clear delivery risk: a hard respondent threshold without fallback can stall Sprint 0 indefinitely. Actionable to add timeout/fallback decision rules and owner. Low implementation cost, high planning ROI.

Security-critical and concrete. Redaction patterns cannot remain undefined behind a future verification note. Either lock an initial regex now or make Sprint 0 discovery an explicit required artifact. High impact, low-to-moderate effort.
Good contract-hardening improvement. If multiple NFRs depend on ledger queries, schema ambiguity will create inconsistent telemetry and auditability. Moderate effort but strong downstream value.

High-value operational realism. Live integration tests fail in practice without secret handling, fork behavior, and cost controls. This is specific, actionable, and prevents CI fragility and runaway spend.

blockers.concern: Bearer-token-only v1 may not satisfy enterprise Bedrock deployments that rely on cross-account ARNs and IAM controls
blockers.why_matters: Many AWS organizations enforce IAM role-based access and cross-account inference profiles. Deferring SigV4 may make v1 unusable for the exact high-value users requesting Bedrock support.
blockers.location: Executive Summary (v2 deferred), FR-3, FR-4, FR-12 out-of-scope note
blockers.recommendation: Define explicit v1 support boundaries in release criteria and add a contingency: if Sprint 0 detects cross-account/SigV4 dependency, re-scope to minimal SigV4 MVP in this cycle.

blockers.concern: Colon-bearing model IDs introduce multi-language parsing/escaping risk across Bash and Python layers
blockers.why_matters: The design depends on first-colon split semantics across generators, loaders, adapters, and shell maps. Any inconsistency can break model resolution, permissions, or cost mapping in subtle ways.
blockers.location: FR-1 acceptance criteria (colon handling), generated-model-maps/model-adapter integration points
blockers.recommendation: Centralize parsing into one canonical utility shared by all paths (or generate pre-split fields), and add end-to-end property tests across Bash/Python boundaries.

blockers.concern: Compliance fallback defaults are internally ambiguous and risk accidental cross-provider egress
blockers.why_matters: The PRD references both 'none default for pre-cycle users' and 'bedrock_only default for Bedrock-configured users'. Ambiguity in migration/default semantics can cause non-compliant fallback behavior in regulated environments.
blockers.location: G-S0-3 Compliance Profile Decision; NFR-R1 revised behavior
blockers.recommendation: Specify deterministic defaulting/migration logic per user state, and add automated migration tests proving no silent fallback under compliance-sensitive configurations.

blockers.concern: Critical Bedrock contract verification is manual and non-repeatable in CI
blockers.why_matters: Core assumptions (endpoints, response shapes, thinking traces, tool schema behavior) are validated once by a maintainer-side probe. AWS behavior can drift by region/time; without automated regression checks, the integration can silently rot and fail after release.
blockers.location: Pre-Sprint-1 Validation Gate: G-S0-2 Live API Contract Verification; FR-10 Tests
blockers.recommendation: Promote a subset of contract probes into recurring, key-gated CI smoke tests with fixture diffing and alerting on shape changes.

blockers.concern: Sprint 0 user-validation sample is too small and may misclassify the primary auth mode
blockers.why_matters: The plan gates v1 auth direction on feedback from only >=2 users. If those users are not representative, the team could ship Bearer-token v1 while most real adopters require SigV4/IAM, forcing a costly rework and failed launch.
blockers.location: Pre-Sprint-1 Validation Gate: G-S0-1 Auth-Modality User Confirmation
blockers.recommendation: Increase validation to a broader sample (e.g., all known Bedrock users + at least one enterprise platform owner), and add a hard go/no-go threshold by user share (e.g., >=70% Bearer-token to keep FR-3 as v1).
